adventure.title: Bike the Riverfront Trail to the Old Chain of Rocks Bridge
adventure.description: Pedal the paved riverfront trail north to a mile-long pedestrian bridge with a dramatic bend over the Mississippi.
adventure.bonus: Stop at the bridge's bend and take a photo looking both directions.

adventure.title: Kayak Creve Coeur Lake
adventure.description: Paddle a rented kayak around the four-mile shoreline of this county park lake just outside the city.
adventure.bonus: Paddle to the far shore before you turn back.

adventure.title: Stand Where the Dred Scott Case Began at the Old Courthouse
adventure.description: Step inside the domed 1839 courthouse where an enslaved man's fight for freedom helped set the Civil War in motion.
adventure.bonus: Read one placard out loud to your group.

adventure.title: Catch a Live Sky Show at the James S. McDonnell Planetarium
adventure.description: Tilt back under a freshly upgraded dome and watch the night sky come alive in vivid full-dome projection.
adventure.bonus: Pick a constellation and learn its story before you leave.

adventure.title: Bike the Grant's Trail
adventure.description: Ride the paved rail-trail connecting Kirkwood to south St. Louis County through quiet wooded corridors.
adventure.bonus: Ride to the far end and back without checking your phone once.

adventure.title: Pose With Giant Chess Sets at the World Chess Hall of Fame
adventure.description: Browse trophies and memorabilia from chess legends, then challenge a friend on the oversized outdoor chessboard.
adventure.bonus: Play one move of chess with a total stranger.

adventure.title: Hike the Bluff Trails at Castlewood State Park
adventure.description: Climb switchbacks up limestone bluffs above the Meramec River for panoramic valley views.
adventure.bonus: Take the steepest trail option instead of the easy one.

adventure.title: Run the Forest Park Steeplechase Loop
adventure.description: Lace up and log miles on the historic 5.7-mile loop trail that circles the entire park.
adventure.bonus: Sprint the last quarter mile.

adventure.title: Play a Round at Forest Park Golf Course
adventure.description: Walk nine holes of rolling fairways and century-old trees minutes from downtown at one of the city's oldest courses.
adventure.bonus: Play your worst hole again for fun, no scorecard.

adventure.title: Tour the Original Anheuser-Busch Brewery
adventure.description: Walk the historic brewhouse, peek into the finishing cellar, and sample a fresh-poured beer where Budweiser has been made since 1852.
adventure.bonus: Ask your tour guide one question about the brewing process.

adventure.title: Marvel at the Mosaics Inside Cathedral Basilica of Saint Louis
adventure.description: Wander beneath 42 million shimmering glass tiles forming one of the largest mosaic collections on Earth.
adventure.bonus: Find the mosaic that's your favorite and explain why to whoever you're with.

adventure.title: Ride the Rooftop Ferris Wheel at City Museum
adventure.description: Climb eleven stories above downtown and spin over the St. Louis skyline atop City Museum's one-of-a-kind rooftop park.
adventure.bonus: Find the yellow school bus dangling off the roof and take a photo hanging out of it.

adventure.title: Tee Off at Topgolf St. Louis
adventure.description: Grab a climate-controlled bay, order a round of drinks, and see who can rack up the highest score on tracked balls.
adventure.bonus: Let the worst golfer in the group pick the next round's music.

adventure.title: Meet the Clydesdales on the Grant's Farm Stable Tour
adventure.description: Go behind the scenes with the famous Budweiser Clydesdales and help groom a gentle giant.
adventure.bonus: Ask a handler the name of the horse you meet and remember it.

adventure.title: Play Tennis at the Dwight Davis Tennis Center
adventure.description: Book a public court in Forest Park and knock a few rallies at the home of the Davis Cup's namesake.
adventure.bonus: Play one full game using only your weaker hand's serve toss.

adventure.title: Crack the Case at Escape The Room STL
adventure.description: Lock yourself in with your crew and race the clock to solve puzzles before time runs out.
adventure.bonus: Let the person who talks the least call the final answer.

adventure.title: Play Pickup Volleyball at Tower Grove Park
adventure.description: Join or start a casual game on the park's open courts on a warm afternoon.
adventure.bonus: Invite someone watching from the sidelines to play.

adventure.title: Take a Sunset Paddleboard Tour on the Mississippi with Big Muddy Adventures
adventure.description: Stand up on a board and glide across the Mississippi River as the sun sets behind the Arch on a fully guided tour.
adventure.bonus: Stay standing for the entire first mile, no kneeling allowed.

adventure.title: Cruise the Mississippi on the Tom Sawyer Riverboat
adventure.description: Board a 19th-century paddlewheeler and drift past the Arch on a riverfront cruise down the Mississippi.
adventure.bonus: Stand at the bow and name three things you see on the riverbank.

adventure.title: Take an Outdoor Yoga Class in Forest Park
adventure.description: Roll out a mat on the grass for a guided flow session as the park's seasonal outdoor yoga series returns.
adventure.bonus: Hold the final pose a little longer than the instructor asks.

adventure.title: Ride the Tram to the Top of the Gateway Arch
adventure.description: Squeeze into a capsule car and rise 630 feet for a sweeping view of the Mississippi River and downtown St. Louis.
adventure.bonus: Text a photo from the top to someone who's never been to St. Louis.

adventure.title: Play Among the Sculptures at Citygarden
adventure.description: Weave through two dozen monumental sculptures, splash fountains, and a river-rock stream in this free downtown sculpture park.
adventure.bonus: Climb into the giant head sculpture and take a selfie.

adventure.title: Take a Spin on The Wheel at St. Louis Union Station
adventure.description: Rise 200 feet in a climate-controlled gondola for a glowing night view of the historic train shed and skyline.
adventure.bonus: Pick the gondola color you'd never choose and ride in it anyway.

chill.title: Picnic Under the Victorian Pavilions at Tower Grove Park
chill.description: Spread a blanket near one of the park's ornate 19th-century pavilions and watch the afternoon go by.
chill.bonus: Bring a snack you've never packed for a picnic before.

chill.title: Poke Through the Shops of Cherokee Antique Row
chill.description: Drift down six blocks of hand-painted storefronts crammed with vintage furniture, records, and oddities.
chill.bonus: Buy the strangest small object you find for under $10.

chill.title: Wander the Rainforest Inside the Climatron at Missouri Botanical Garden
chill.description: Step into a 70-foot geodesic dome dripping with waterfalls and over 2,800 tropical plants.
chill.bonus: Find the strangest-looking plant in the dome and name it something new.

chill.title: Spend an Afternoon at The Spa at The Ritz-Carlton, St. Louis
chill.description: Book a signature massage and settle into the sauna and steam room at Clayton's most polished hotel spa.
chill.bonus: Arrive twenty minutes early just to sit in the relaxation lounge.

chill.title: Watch the Sunset from Kiener Plaza by the Arch
chill.description: Grab a spot on the lawn as the sun drops behind downtown and lights up the Gateway Arch in gold.
chill.bonus: Stay until the Arch's lights actually turn on.

chill.title: Browse the Shelves at Left Bank Books
chill.description: Spend an unhurried hour flipping through staff picks at St. Louis's oldest independent bookstore.
chill.bonus: Buy a book with a cover you can't resist, no research allowed.

chill.title: Browse the Galleries at Pulitzer Arts Foundation
chill.description: Move slowly through Tadao Ando's concrete-and-light building and its quietly powerful rotating art exhibits.
chill.bonus: Sit with one piece of art for a full three minutes before moving on.

chill.title: Paddle Boat on Post-Dispatch Lake at The Boathouse
chill.description: Rent a paddle boat and drift lazily across Forest Park's lake with the skyline peeking through the trees.
chill.bonus: Race the boat next to you to the nearest bridge.

chill.title: Sit Quietly Inside the Jewel Box in Forest Park
chill.description: Duck into this Art Deco glass conservatory glowing with seasonal flowers under cantilevered steel arches.
chill.bonus: Sit on a bench for five full minutes without checking your phone.

chill.title: Sip a Glass at Sasha's on DeMun
chill.description: Settle onto the patio of this cozy neighborhood wine bar for a glass poured by people who actually know the list.
chill.bonus: Let the staff pick your glass based on your mood.

chill.title: Get Lost in the Free Galleries of the Saint Louis Art Museum
chill.description: Roam century-spanning collections inside the grand Cass Gilbert building perched above Forest Park, no ticket required.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest piece in the museum and read its full description.

chill.title: Walk Among Free-Flying Butterflies at the Butterfly House
chill.description: Step into a warm glass conservatory where hundreds of butterflies drift freely around you at Faust Park.
chill.bonus: Stand still until a butterfly lands on you.

foodie.title: Feast on Brisket at Bogart's Smokehouse in Soulard
foodie.description: Pile a tray high with Texas-style smoked brisket and apricot-glazed ribs at this Soulard barbecue institution.
foodie.bonus: Get the burnt ends, even if you weren't planning to.

foodie.title: Order a Concrete at Ted Drewes Frozen Custard
foodie.description: Get a frozen custard blended so thick they hand it to you upside down, a St. Louis rite of passage.
foodie.bonus: Order a flavor combo you've never had before.

foodie.title: Get a Pour-Over at Sump Coffee
foodie.description: Sip a meticulously brewed single-origin pour-over at one of South City's most respected coffee roasters.
foodie.bonus: Ask the barista what they're most excited about on the menu.

foodie.title: Shop the Stalls at Soulard Farmers Market
foodie.description: Browse one of the country's oldest public markets for fresh produce, spices, and local treats under one historic roof.
foodie.bonus: Buy a fruit or vegetable you can't name.

foodie.title: Brunch on Crepes at Rooster Downtown
foodie.description: Settle into a corner table for sweet or savory crepes at this cozy downtown brunch favorite.
foodie.bonus: Order a crepe filling you've never tried.

foodie.title: Savor the Tasting Menu at Vicia
foodie.description: Let a James Beard-recognized kitchen walk you through a vegetable-forward tasting menu built from its own garden.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server which dish changed most recently and order it.

foodie.title: Sample Flights at Urban Chestnut's Grove Bierhall
foodie.description: Work through a flight of German-style lagers and ales at this brewery's bierhall in The Grove.
foodie.bonus: Order the one beer name you can't pronounce.

foodie.title: Take the Free Brewery Tour at Schlafly Bottleworks
foodie.description: Walk the brewhouse floor with a guide and finish with a tasting flight of St. Louis's original craft beer.
foodie.bonus: Order the flight and rank the beers out loud.

foodie.title: Wait in Line for Ribs at Pappy's Smokehouse
foodie.description: Join the sidewalk queue for Memphis-style ribs that once got voted the best in America.
foodie.bonus: Strike up a conversation with someone in line.

foodie.title: Graze the Food Hall at City Foundry STL
foodie.description: Sample dishes from a dozen-plus local kitchens under one roof inside a converted midcentury iron foundry.
foodie.bonus: Order from the vendor with the shortest line, on purpose.

foodie.title: Taste a Slice of Gooey Butter Cake at Park Avenue Coffee
foodie.description: Pick a flavor from dozens of varieties of St. Louis's beloved, impossibly sweet gooey butter cake.
foodie.bonus: Let the barista pick your flavor for you.

foodie.title: Order the Original Toasted Ravioli at Charlie Gitto's on The Hill
foodie.description: Dig into St. Louis's signature fried pasta appetizer at the Italian dining room that helped make it famous.
foodie.bonus: Order one dish neither of you has tried before.

social.title: Bowl a Few Frames at Pin-Up Bowl
social.description: Rent lanes at this retro eight-lane bowling alley and cocktail lounge tucked into the Delmar Loop.
social.bonus: Bowl one frame with your non-dominant hand.

social.title: Cheer on the Blues at Enterprise Center
social.description: Feel the ice-level roar as the St. Louis Blues take the ice in front of a sellout downtown crowd.
social.bonus: Learn one player's name and cheer for them by name.

social.title: Test Your Team at Trivia Night at Schlafly Tap Room
social.description: Huddle with your crew over pints of local beer and battle other tables for trivia bragging rights.
social.bonus: Let the quietest person in your group answer the final question.

social.title: Throw Axes at The Axe House
social.description: Grip a hatchet and take aim at a wooden target with your friends cheering (or heckling) behind you.
social.bonus: Make a bet on who sticks the first bullseye.

social.title: See a Touring Broadway Show at the Fox Theatre
social.description: Dress up and take your seat under the ornate gilded ceiling of St. Louis's grandest historic theater for a national touring production.
social.bonus: Read the Playbill cover to cover before the lights go down.

social.title: Catch a Show at The Improv Shop
social.description: Watch local improvisers build a full show out of a single audience suggestion at this scrappy two-stage theater.
social.bonus: Shout out the audience suggestion when they ask for one.

social.title: Watch the Game at Ballpark Village's Budweiser Brew House
social.description: Post up on the big patio outside Busch Stadium and watch the game surrounded by a crowd in red.
social.bonus: High-five a stranger after the next big play.

social.title: Catch a St. Louis Cardinals Game at Busch Stadium
social.description: Grab a seat with the Gateway Arch framed over the outfield and cheer on eleven-time World Series champs.
social.bonus: Buy a hot dog you wouldn't normally order and eat it in your seat.

social.title: Sing Karaoke Wednesdays at HandleBar
social.description: Grab the mic on the patio of this bike-themed Grove neighborhood bar and belt one out for the crowd.
social.bonus: Sing a song you've never attempted in public before.

social.title: Catch Live Music at Broadway Oyster Bar
social.description: Squeeze onto the patio of this Cajun-Creole institution for nightly live blues, funk, and roots music.
social.bonus: Request a song from the band, even if they say no.

social.title: Laugh Out Loud at Helium Comedy Club
social.description: Grab a table close to the stage for a night of national touring stand-up comics in an intimate room.
social.bonus: Sit in the first three rows, no matter how nervous that makes you.

social.title: Play Bingo Night at Urban Chestnut's Midtown Biergarten
social.description: Grab a table in the beer garden for a free weekly round of bingo with pints of German-style lager.
social.bonus: Shout bingo louder than you need to.
